name: Arena 3D
description: A low-poly 3D arena: walk, jump, crouch and push boxes around with your friends. The starter kit for SIDE ROOM's 3D games.
_comment: JSON has no comments, and crates/sr-activities reads only the keys it knows, so this note and the key below are ignored by the server. D-399: ingame_voice (spatial voice, see client/spatial-voice.js) and byos_write are reserved. A bundle may declare them, but the runtime refuses them until the platform ships them. To opt in early, move them from _reserved_capabilities_example into capabilities.
